about: State Bank of India provides banking products and services in India and internationally. The company operates through the Treasury, Corporate/Wholesale Banking, Retail Banking, and Other Banking Business segments. It offers personal banking products and services, including current, savings, salary, and deposit accounts; home, personal, pension, auto, education, and gold loans, as well as loans against insurance property, and securities; debit, business debit, prepaid, and green remit cards; over
